scheme.label: Palette
scheme.description: How the cover color becomes a full palette. System follows the wallpaper scheme set in Noctalia. Black and white covers always get a neutral palette.

hold.label: When playback stops
hold.description: How long the album colors stay after a pause before the previous palette comes back

delay_ms.label: Update delay (ms)
delay_ms.description: How long the track has to settle before the palette changes

ignore_players.label: Ignored players
ignore_players.description: playerctl player names that never theme the desktop, for example chromium
